desc:
🚛🚌 INDONESIAN TRUCK & BUS 🇮🇩

Become a truck and bus driver on Indonesian roads! Deliver cargo, transport passengers, and upgrade your fleet!

🌴 Haul palm oil, rubber, timber, concrete, and stone
🚏 Drive intercity bus routes
⛰️ Navigate the steep climbs and curves of Kelok Sembilan
🎨 Customize your truck + add a 'telolet' horn 📢

📱 Playable on mobile and PC
